subject: CS350
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos covering all 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The English selections are primarily from major educational channels like Neso Academy and Gate Smashers, ensuring high quality and relevance. The Arabic selections leverage the excellent, in-depth lecture series from channels like 'محمد الدسوقى' and 'عاهد بدر'. One exception to the view count rule was made for an Arabic video on 'Data Independence' as it was significantly more relevant than any higher-viewed alternatives.

coverage.note: Selected candidate has <3000 views, but no other highly relevant candidate passed the view count gate.
